# Co-Signer Liability

The co-signer named above is jointly and severally liable for the full outstanding balance of this account. The primary borrower is 43 days past due as at the statement date. Where an account is 30 days or more past due, the lender is entitled to pursue the co-signer directly for the arrears and for the balance in full.

The primary borrower is an adult dependent of the co-signer and resides at a different address. This account is documented in the primary borrower's name and is not reported on the co-signer's consumer credit report.

## Clause 11 - Personal Guarantee

The Guarantor unconditionally and irrevocably guarantees to the Lender the full and punctual payment of all obligations of the Borrower under this Note. This guarantee is unlimited in amount, is not contingent on any prior action against the Borrower, and survives any change in the ownership or capital structure of the Borrower.

The Guarantor acknowledges that this obligation is a direct personal liability and is enforceable against the Guarantor's personal assets.
